entities.name: Johannes van Vloten
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes van Vloten was a Dutch scholar, literary historian and philosopher. He is known as a rediscoverer of Spinoza's work and a freethinker in his tradition, with a great deal of involvement in all kinds of social issues. Van Vloten was one of the founders of modern humanism.
